data.name: Moomin
data.long_meaning: A friendly and kind-hearted creature from Finnish folklore, often depicted as a round-bodied, white, tusked, and sometimes hooded creature, living in the Moominvalley.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the importance of kindness, friendship, and imagination in one's life.
data.numerology_meaning: A nurturing and harmonizing energy, encouraging love, care, and responsibility.
